subject: Post-call recap & procurement handoff — purchase channel decision needed
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & procurement handoff — purchase channel decision needed

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Outcome from our call: Acme is interested in a small pilot (10–50 seats) to validate intent/latency for the product search assistant, with potential enterprise rollout in Q1 if results look good.
- Procurement options discussed: (1) PO + vendor onboarding (preferred for enterprise), (2) corporate card for pilot, or (3) AWS Marketplace (card or invoice depending on marketplace terms).

What we need from Acme to progress:
1) Confirm which purchasing channel you prefer for the pilot (card vs PO vs marketplace).
2) If PO: please send your standard PO form / vendor setup spreadsheet + remit details and the target payment terms (Net30/Net45).
3) If marketplace: confirm whether your procurement team requires marketplace invoicing or can accept card-based purchase.
4) Any legal/data handling must-haves we should reflect in the SOW (you mentioned a short clause around data retention).

Attached: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (draft, editable). I can send a DocuSign-ready SOW once you confirm channel and any legal asks.

Proposed timeline: if we get the vendor form/PO by next week (Aug 31) we can start the pilot the week after. If you prefer card/marketplace we can typically start within 48–72 hours.

I'll follow up with a short checklist internally to confirm billing path and to get finance vendor details ready. Please let me know the preferred route and I will route the right docs.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Price <samantha@acme.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & procurement handoff — purchase channel decision needed

Thanks Aditya — good summary. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- We're open to starting on a corporate card for the pilot for speed, but enterprise procurement will prefer a PO and vendor onboarding for the full rollout.
- Please send the editable SOW; procurement wants to review data retention & deletion language (specific clause).
- Attached is our vendor setup form (Acme_Vendor_Form_2026.xlsx) — please complete and return. It includes remit address, W-9 requirement, and internal vendor code fields.

Can you also confirm Redwood's legal entity for invoicing and the contact in finance for vendor setup?

Samantha Price
Director, Vendor Ops — Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

Adding a quick internal note so we're aligned before Aditya sends formal vendor-facing materials: 

- Pricing: confirm which SKU/pricing will be used for the pilot (monthly seat vs usage). If pilot is card-based we should use the pilot SKU with a short-term discount code; if PO, use standard enterprise SKU & list expected T&Cs.
- Vendor onboarding: Finance needs the completed Acme_Vendor_Form + a scanned W-9. I uploaded our standard W-9 (W9_Redwood_FY26.pdf) to the drive link and will prep the vendor profile once we get the form back.
- Marketplace: if Acme prefers AWS Marketplace we need to confirm whether they require marketplace invoicing vs direct invoicing. Marketplace sales typically add a small delay for seller activation.

Action items for Ben: can you confirm pilot SKU and verify if there are any marketplace passthrough constraints from our side? For Aditya: once you get Acme's preference, I can push vendor onboarding in our system.

-Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & procurement handoff — purchase channel decision needed

Hi Samantha / Acme procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the vendor form. Below is the straightforward path depending on which route you pick: 

Option A — Pilot on corporate card (fastest)
- Timeline: 48–72 hours after payment method confirmed.
- Pros: fastest time-to-value, no vendor onboarding.
- Cons: less ideal for enterprise billing/PO reconciliation.

Option B — PO + vendor onboarding (recommended for rollout)
- Timeline: vendor form + W-9 returned -> finance creates vendor profile (2–5 business days) -> PO processed -> pilot start.
- Required from Acme: completed Acme_Vendor_Form_2026.xlsx, a scanned PO or PO number, remit name/address, and contact for AP.
- We can accept Net30; if you need Net45 flag that in the vendor form and we will route.

Option C — AWS Marketplace (if you want marketplace billing)
- Timeline: depends on marketplace activation; could add ~5 business days to seller enablement. Good for central IT buy-in.

I've attached the editable SOW again (Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) and our W-9 (W9_Redwood_FY26.pdf). I also created a DocuSign-ready copy here: https://app.docusign.com/s/ABC123-redwood-sow — signable if you want to lock in dates/terms.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) For pilot speed: confirm card and I'll issue an invoice receipt immediately.
2) For enterprise readiness: return the completed vendor form + W-9 and a sample PO number and Marissa will trigger vendor setup.

If you want, I can also prepare a short mutual action plan with milestones for vendor onboarding — let me know and I'll send it.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf, W9_Redwood_FY26.pdf

Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick weekly check-in — where are we on vendor setup / PO?

Hi Samantha / Acme procurement — quick nudge from our side as part of the weekly cadence: where is this stuck? A few easy things we can do to move forward: 

- If you want to start now, we can accept a corporate card for the pilot and start within 48–72 hours.
- If you're aiming for PO, please send back Acme_Vendor_Form_2026.xlsx (filled) + W-9 and a sample PO or PO number so our finance team can create your vendor profile.
- If marketplace is preferred, confirm whether you need marketplace invoicing or card purchase there.

We want to make the pilot frictionless — happy to hop on a 15-minute call this week to unblock.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Principal Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
